title: Compact snapshot strip: SDK orchestration onboarding assets (auth, streaming, tool calling)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Produce a compact "snapshot strip" asset set for API/SDK onboarding docs and the quickstart flow. Focus areas: device-code / tokenless auth, API key lifecycle & rotation, streaming responses UI, and tool-calling visualization. Assets should be small, horizontally-arranged ‘strip’ screenshots and micro-illustrations that can be embedded in docs and the Console quickstart modal. Prioritize clarity at small sizes (320–680px width), include annotated alt text and developer-focused microcopy variants.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver 10 PNG snapshot strips (3 sizes: mobile/compact/tablet) showing auth, key rotation, streaming, and tool-calling scenarios
Supply 6 vector SVG micro-illustrations (authorization flow, token refresh, streaming progress, tool call handshake, callback payload, error fallback)
Figma file with organized pages and exportable slices; naming convention matches docs asset naming guide
All images include alt-text, short caption, and 1-sentence dev-focused code hint for embedding
PM and engineering sign-off on technical accuracy (esp. token rotation and streaming lifecycle)
tasks: Audit existing onboarding imagery and list gaps (auth, streaming progress, tool-call sequence)
Create wireframe strip layouts for three widths and share for early feedback
Design micro-illustrations with token/key metaphors avoiding complex metaphors (no padlocks over chips)
Implement annotated screenshots in staging Console; capture high-DPI exports
Prepare exports + alt text + captions and upload to docs assets bucket
Collect sign-offs and iterate on engineering feedback
comments: 2025-01-21 Maya Chen: Initial brief complete. Pulled existing assets and noted inconsistent visual language for streaming indicators — some use dots, some use progress bars. Recommend standardizing on a thin, left-to-right progress bar with subtle pulsing to indicate live tokens.

2025-01-24 Liam O'Connor: Wireframes uploaded to Figma (link below). Request engineering confirmation on the streaming lifecycle states we should depict: connecting, receiving-first-token, steady-stream, rebuffer/fallback.

2025-01-27 Rohan Patel (Engineering): Confirmed states. Also flagged that key rotation in Dedicated requires two-step rotation (issue ENG-4219). Need one frame showing ephemeral key swap and one showing developer console confirmation.
2025-01-30 Maya Chen: First pass of compact strips exported (mobile/tablet). Shared with Docs for copy alignment. Docs suggested shorter captions that fit two-line layout in the quickstart modal.

2025-02-02 Design critique: PM (Erin Wallace) prefers more explicit callouts for tool-calling: show request -> tool invoke -> tool response -> model continues. Added a micro-illustration sequence to represent callback hooks.

2025-02-04 Liam O'Connor: Iterated assets uploaded to staging Console for visual QA. Found text legibility issue at 320px width; increased font weight and tightened spacing. Preparing final export set tomorrow.
2025-02-05 Maya Chen: Updated acceptance criteria to include alt-text and 1-sentence code hint per image. Ready for PM/ENG review.
2025-02-05 Erin Wallace (PM): Quick thumbs-up on accuracy; requested final export naming convention: onboard-snap-{area}-{size}-{ver}.png (e.g., onboard-snap-auth-mobile-v1.png)
